settings.ai.intro: The AI Reader is a second pair of eyes on your manuscript. It helps with feedback, persona and style checks, facts, continuity and consistency, but it does not take over the writing. It does not write or rewrite manuscript text and never edits your manuscript autonomously. QuietWriter does not include an AI model itself: connect a local model through Ollama or an external model through OpenRouter.

settings.ai.openrouter_key_help: Only relevant when OpenRouter is selected. The key is stored locally in your QuietWriter settings.
settings.ai.model_help:
QuietWriter sends only the context selected in the Reader sidebar together with your writer persona.
🆓 = free via OpenRouter according to the most recently fetched pricing information.
🧠 = the provider reports that this model supports thinking/reasoning. QuietWriter can request thinking to be disabled when the provider allows it; some model variants may ignore that request. Without thinking, responses are often faster and more direct. The effect varies by model.
settings.ai.disable_thinking_help: Asks the selected provider to disable reasoning/thinking when the model supports it. Leave this off to use the model default.
settings.ai.quick_actions_expanded_help: Shows the three Reader quick actions immediately when the panel opens. When off, they remain available through the Quick actions button without permanently using space.

persona.title: Writer persona
persona.info: Your writer persona helps the Reader get to know you as a writer. Use it to describe what is characteristic of your voice, tone, rhythm, word choice and editorial preferences. This lets the Reader point out when a passage does or does not fit your own style without writing that style for you. The persona applies to all books; a Book profile can define deliberate exceptions for one specific book. This context is sent with each Reader request to the selected AI provider; with an external provider, this data leaves your computer.

persona.section.voice_tone.title: Voice & tone
persona.section.voice_tone.help: How should the text feel? Consider directness, warmth, distance, humor, darkness or sensuality.
persona.section.narration.title: Narrative style
persona.section.narration.help: Point of view, tense, narrative distance and how much the narrator explains versus shows.
persona.section.language.title: Language & word choice
persona.section.language.help: Vocabulary, concrete or abstract language, jargon, explicitness and recurring preferences.
persona.section.rhythm.title: Sentences & rhythm
persona.section.rhythm.help: Sentence length, cadence, variation, fragments, paragraph rhythm and pace.
persona.section.description.title: Description & senses
persona.section.description.help: How much detail you use for surroundings, appearance, body, sound, smell, touch and other senses.
persona.section.dialogue.title: Dialogue & interaction
persona.section.dialogue.help: How characters speak, how much subtext you use, and how dialogue, action and thoughts alternate.
persona.section.emotion_intimacy.title: Emotion, tension & intimacy
persona.section.emotion_intimacy.help: How explicitly or implicitly you handle emotion, conflict, romance, physicality, intimacy and violence.
persona.section.scenes_pacing.title: Scenes & pacing
persona.section.scenes_pacing.help: How scenes begin and end, information is paced, and tension, calm and transitions are built.
persona.section.editorial.title: Editorial preferences
persona.section.editorial.help: What the Reader should pay attention to during feedback and analysis, and which characteristics of your own style it should safeguard.
persona.section.avoid.title: Avoid
persona.section.avoid.help: Clichés, words, phrasing, narrative tricks and AI habits that do not fit your style.
persona.section.examples.title: Example texts
persona.section.examples.help: Short excerpts of your own writing or descriptions of passages that represent your desired style well.
persona.section.additional.title: Additional instructions
persona.section.additional.help: Free-form instructions that do not fit the other sections. Older free-form persona content is preserved here without loss.
book_profile.section.genre_audience.help: Genre, subgenre, intended readers and any expectations you deliberately want to follow or break.
book_profile.section.premise.title: Core premise
book_profile.section.premise.help: What is this book essentially about? Describe the central situation, promise or question without repeating the full synopsis.
book_profile.section.narration.title: Point of view & tense
book_profile.section.narration.help: Point of view, tense, narrative distance and any rules for switching viewpoints.
book_profile.section.tone.title: Mood & tone
book_profile.section.tone.help: The desired mood of this specific book and how it may differ from your general writer persona.
book_profile.section.themes.title: Themes & motifs
book_profile.section.themes.help: Recurring themes, motifs, contrasts or ideas that hold the book together thematically.
book_profile.section.setting.title: Setting & world
book_profile.section.setting.help: The broader world, period and environment of the book. Keep concrete canon facts in Planning where possible; use this mainly for the rules and atmosphere of the world.
book_profile.section.pacing.title: Pacing & tension arc
book_profile.section.pacing.help: Desired pacing, build-up of tension and calm, chapter rhythm and how information is revealed.
book_profile.section.intensity.title: Relationships, romance & intensity
book_profile.section.intensity.help: How this book handles relationships, romance, intimacy, conflict, violence and emotional intensity.
book_profile.section.persona_overrides.h: Only deliberate exceptions for this book. These instructions take priority over your general writer persona for this project.
book_profile.section.editorial.title: Editorial focus
book_profile.section.editorial.help: Specific things AI should watch for in this book, such as viewpoint discipline, audience, tension level or recurring pitfalls.
book_profile.section.additional.title: Additional instructions
book_profile.section.additional.help: Free-form book instructions that do not fit the other sections.
book_memory.section.canon.title: Canon & facts
book_memory.section.canon.help: Book-wide facts AI should continue to know. Use Planning for data already structured there; avoid duplicate sources of truth.
book_memory.section.book_style.title: Style of this book
book_memory.section.book_style.help: Style patterns that emerged while writing and are more specific than the Book profile, such as how emotion, description or viewpoint are handled in practice.
book_memory.section.decisions.title: Decisions
book_memory.section.decisions.help: Choices deliberately made while writing or working with AI that do not need to be reconsidered later.
book_memory.section.preferences.title: Recurring preferences
book_memory.section.preferences.help: Book-specific preferences you have given AI repeatedly and that remain relevant in later conversations.
book_memory.section.open_points.title: Open points
book_memory.section.open_points.help: Questions, continuity issues or other matters intentionally left unresolved that AI may remind you about later. Remove them when they are no longer current.
ai.quick.feedback.label: Feedback
ai.quick.feedback.tooltip: Enter a prompt for focused editorial feedback.
ai.quick.feedback.prompt: Give concrete editorial feedback on the supplied text. Identify the main strengths and areas for improvement. Check relevant facts, continuity and style against the writer persona, book profile, book memory and selected Planning context. Give advice and points to consider, but do not write or rewrite manuscript text.
ai.quick.persona_check.label: Persona check
ai.quick.persona_check.tooltip: Enter a prompt to check style and voice against the persona and book profile.
ai.quick.persona_check.prompt: Check the supplied text against my writer persona and book profile. Mention only concrete deviations that truly matter, with brief improvement advice. Do not provide replacement manuscript text.
ai.quick.fact_check.label: Fact check
ai.quick.fact_check.tooltip: Enter a prompt for fact and continuity checking.
ai.quick.fact_check.prompt: Check the supplied manuscript text for factual continuity and contradictions with Book memory and the selected Planning context. Clearly distinguish current manuscript text, previously established facts and planned information. Mention only concrete deviations or uncertainties.

first_run.title: Welcome to QuietWriter
first_run.language_text: Choose the application language and colour scheme. You can change everything later in Settings.
first_run.workspace_text: QuietWriter stores your books, planning and local recovery data here. Production and development can use separate workspaces.
first_run.spelling_text: QuietWriter uses Hunspell dictionaries. The portable build includes Dutch by default; detected system dictionaries are shown too.
first_run.ai_text: The AI Reader is an optional second pair of eyes on your own text: for feedback, persona and style checks, facts, continuity and consistency. It does not write for you and is off by default. Ollama stays local. With OpenRouter, text and context you deliberately send may leave your computer.
splash.ai_skipped: AI is off · starting the editor
ai.warmup.prompt: Start this new conversation with a short introduction as my reading assistant. In 2 to 4 sentences, explain that you can give feedback on my own text, including persona checks, fact checks, continuity and consistency. Mention that I can select a passage and ask a question about it. Make clear that you read and advise while I remain the writer. Do not write or rewrite manuscript text.
ai.warmup.welcome: I am your reading assistant. I can give feedback on your own text, including persona checks, fact checks, continuity and consistency. Select a passage and ask me a question about it; I read along and advise, but I do not take over the writing.
settings.ai.openrouter_free_only_help: Shows only OpenRouter models whose current prompt and output prices are zero. Use Fetch models to refresh the price status.
settings.ai.openrouter_free_tip: Free via OpenRouter according to the most recently fetched pricing information.
editor.text_width.tip: Text width only changes the view, not your manuscript or export.
settings.appearance.text_width_help: Controls how much white space appears to the left and right of the text. This only changes the view and does not affect your manuscript or export.

darlings.title: Darlings
darlings.info: Don't kill your darlings. Sometimes you write a sentence, paragraph or scene you really do not want to lose, even though it no longer belongs in the story. Keep those fragments in Darlings instead of deleting them for good. Take them out of the manuscript, give them a place here, and use them again later when they find a better home.

first_run.update_text: QuietWriter can ask GitHub whether a newer stable version is available. No books, manuscripts or other content are sent. You can always check manually in Settings.
first_run.update_privacy: Automatic checking is only a short version check. QuietWriter never downloads or installs anything without your action.
first_run.tour_text: New writers should not have to figure QuietWriter out by themselves. The next screens briefly explain where to find your books, writing, planning, Darlings, AI Reader, history and export.
first_run.tour_enable: Show me briefly where everything is
first_run.tour_optional: The tour is explanation only. You can skip it; every feature remains available.
first_run.tour_books_text: Your books live on the Bookshelf. Open a book to write and organise chapters. QuietWriter saves automatically while you write; Version History helps you recover earlier versions.
first_run.tour_planning_text: Planning keeps scenes, characters and notes together. In Darlings: Don't kill your darlings. Keep beautiful pieces that no longer fit, find them later and reuse them elsewhere.
first_run.tour_finish_text: The optional AI Reader gives feedback on your text, but does not write it for you. Export creates formats including EPUB, PDF and Markdown. Integrity & recovery and Trash help when you need to inspect or restore something.
first_run.tour_finish_tip: You do not have to remember all of this. QuietWriter keeps the interface calm and you can always change settings later.
first_run.theme_preview_text: This preview changes immediately. Choose what feels comfortable to read; you can always change it later.
settings.updates.auto_help: After startup, asks GitHub only for the newest stable version. No books or manuscripts are sent and QuietWriter downloads nothing automatically.
settings.updates.manual_help: You can always check manually, even when automatic checking is disabled.
settings.reset.label: Set up QuietWriter again
settings.reset.help: Restores program settings and shows the complete setup again at the next launch. Your books and stories are not deleted.
settings.reset.title: Set up QuietWriter again
settings.reset.confirm_title: Restore program settings to their defaults?
settings.reset.confirm_text: QuietWriter will forget your preferences and show the complete setup again at the next launch. A saved OpenRouter API key is also removed. Your current workspace with books and stories stays in place and is not modified.

settings.reset.error_text: The settings could not be reset reliably. Your workspace was not modified.
settings.reset.ready_text: QuietWriter will now quit. The setup starts again on the next launch. Your stories stay in the same workspace.

export.wizard.purpose.print_help: Fixed pages, like a real book. For proofreaders on paper or a printer.
export.wizard.purpose.word_help: For an editor or reader who adds comments and changes in Word.
export.wizard.purpose.share_help: Your whole book in one file: text, images and Planning. Without your old versions.
export.wizard.purpose.backup_help: Everything in one file, including your version history. QuietWriter can restore it completely later.
export.wizard.purpose.website: Put it on a website or blog
export.wizard.purpose.website_help: Plain text with a fixed header, ready to paste into your site.
export.wizard.purpose.manual_hint: Already know exactly which format and settings you want? Choose Set up myself at the top right. QuietWriter remembers your choice.

export.wizard.tip.ereader: Kobo and most other e-readers: connect them with a cable and drag the file onto them. Phone or tablet: open the file in Apple Books, Google Play Books or another e-book app.
export.wizard.tip.print: Open the PDF and choose Print. For A5 use the “Actual size” setting, otherwise the page is enlarged.
export.wizard.tip.word: Getting the file back with changes? Choose Import book on the Bookshelf. It arrives as a new book; your current book stays untouched.

export.wizard.tip.share: Send the file to the other QuietWriter user. They choose Import book on the Bookshelf.
export.wizard.tip.backup: Choose Import book on the Bookshelf and select this file. QuietWriter restores the book with everything in it.
export.wizard.tip.website: Open the file in a text editor and paste the content into your site, or upload it as a Markdown file.

settings.help.label: Panel explanations
settings.help.help: Shows the short explanations in the right-hand panels again, as on first use. Your books and settings stay as they are.
settings.help.reset_done: Explanations are shown again in all panels.
panel_help.search: Search this chapter, this section or the whole book. Replace matches one at a time, or all at once with Replace all.
panel_help.chapter_context: Here you see the scenes and characters you linked to this chapter in Planning, so your plan is at hand while you write. To change them, go to Planning.
panel_help.open_points: Mark words or passages you want to fill in later, instead of typing XXX or TODO. QuietWriter keeps track of them here and warns you before an export. The marker itself never ends up in your export.
panel_help.ai: Ask a question about your text, or select a passage and pick a quick action. The answer appears here; your manuscript only changes when you edit it yourself. Under Context you can see what is sent.
panel_help.spell: Go through the unknown words in this chapter one by one. Ignore skips only this spot; Ignore all lasts until you close QuietWriter. Always ignore and Add to dictionary remember the word for good.
panel_help.history: Every day you write, QuietWriter automatically keeps a version of your book. Create a version yourself before a big change, and star the versions that matter.
panel_help.darlings: Keep text you cut but don't want to lose here. Select a passage and copy or cut it to Darlings. Everything you keep can be found again via Open Darlings.

book.syntax_migration.title: Update book once
book.syntax_migration.text:
This book was created with an older QuietWriter version.

QuietWriter needs to record the manuscript syntax once so existing text keeps looking the same and new input can be stored safely. A recovery version is created automatically first.

Update the book now?
book.syntax_migration.failed_text:
The book was not updated. The original version was preserved.

{error}
book.syntax_migration.ambiguous_text:
This book contains backslashes that cannot safely be identified as old or new automatically.

If the book was edited recently in QuietWriter and the text looks correct now, keep the current display. Choose Protect old text only if the book has not been edited since safe escaping was introduced.
